summary.intent: Run the GSD manager dashboard to check milestone progress, resolve a stalled Phase 69, dispatch Phase 70 planning and Phase 71 discussion in parallel, and work through Phase 71's design decisions (root ownership, CID equivocation guard, re-claim semantics).
summary.outcome: Phase 69 was confirmed already merged/verified and marked complete in GSD despite a dashboard glob bug showing it as partial; Phase 71 discussion completed with 9 decisions captured in CONTEXT.md/DISCUSSION-LOG.md; but a background plan-70 agent switched the shared checkout to its own branch, stranding all uncommitted work (Phase 69 completion edits + Phase 71 context) on the wrong branch, left uncommitted pending manual branch separation.

repo: GSD manager's init.manager plan-counter globs *PLAN*.md and miscounts non-plan files containing 'PLAN' as a substring (e.g. 69-WRITE-PLANE-RESEARCH.md) as an extra plan, causing fully-complete phases to show 'partial' status; `gsd-tools verify phase-completeness <N>` is the authoritative check and is not affected by this bug.

`vaults` table (vault.entity.ts) is the authoritative FK-backed store for user->root ownership: owner_id is a unique FK to users.id, plus root_ipns_name column. `ipns_records.user_id` is explicitly documented in the entity as a denormalized creator marker only — authority there is proven by record signature, not row ownership.

Phase 67's TEE lease-renewer rewrite made same-sequence CID repointing structurally impossible: renewIpnsRecord re-signs the existing value+sequence with no metadataCid in the request body, and republish uses a separate EOL-only write path that never touches latestCid — so same-seq + different-CID is always an anomaly, never a legitimate TEE behavior.
share-invite.service.ts createInvite currently copies rootIpnsName/rootNodeId verbatim from untrusted client DTO with no server-side ownership lookup — only sharerId is authenticated.
No server store persists a root's nodeId (rootNodeId only lives on shares/share_invites), so the (rootIpnsName, rootNodeId) pair can't be fully validated server-side without a schema change.

settings.local.json in this repo is gitignored and already has a worktree config block; adding bgIsolation: "none" there disables the background-write isolation guard for the repo without touching committed settings.json.

comment describes the now-obsolete TEE re-sign contract; needs update

workflow: Manager's compound 'Continue' action can dispatch a plan/execute phase as a backgrounded Agent while running a discuss phase inline in the same session — but on Claude Code, backgrounded agents operate on the same shared working tree with no worktree isolation, so a background plan agent switching branches collides with concurrent inline work in the same checkout.

gsd-tools phase complete updates ROADMAP/STATE/requirements but the manager dashboard's init.manager query can still show stale/miscounted status on refresh due to unrelated disk-glob bugs — worth double-checking with verify subcommands rather than trusting the dashboard alone after a manual completion.

friction: Bg-isolation write guard blocked writing 71-CONTEXT.md to .planning/, requiring editing settings.local.json to disable it before the write would succeed.

Background plan-70 agent switched the shared working tree to its own feature branch (feat/rotation-soundness-deep-merge-fresh-record-resume) mid-session, stranding Phase 71 discussion artifacts and Phase 69 completion edits on the wrong branch and blocking any clean commit.
Dashboard incorrectly showed Phase 69 as 'partial' despite being fully merged with passing verification and green CI, due to a plan-file glob miscounting a research doc as an extra plan.
Had to manually trace CI gate status on the merged PR to confirm Phase 69 was truly safe to mark complete, since GSD's own state was misleading.
open_items: Separate the three uncommitted work streams (Phase 69-completion docs, Phase 70 plans, Phase 71 context) onto their own branches/PRs once the background plan-70 agent finishes.

rootNodeId remains client-asserted and unvalidated server-side for Phase 71 (D-02 gap) — a future phase would need to persist root_node_id on vaults to fully validate the (rootIpnsName, rootNodeId) pair.
SC#3 (ipns_records partial index) flagged for revision since it's redundant with vaults.owner_id uniqueness.
Stale Pitfall-4 test (ipns.service.spec.ts:2124,2131) and misleading comment (ipns.service.ts:313) need rewriting to match the confirmed TEE contract — deferred to Phase 71 plan/execute.
The init.manager plan-file glob miscount bug (matching 'PLAN' substring in unrelated filenames) remains unfixed in GSD tooling.
Phase 71 decisions (root ownership, CID hard-guard, re-claim merge semantics, mechanical fixes) are locked in CONTEXT.md but not yet planned/implemented — next step is /gsd-plan-phase 71.
